scenes.image: Vertical close-up of a shiny red fruit on a branch, the Serpent curled around it grinning slyly.
lines: [smooth, oily] One bite... and you'll know everything.

scenes.image: Eve on a crowded balcony, flat and unimpressed.
lines: [flat] Do you know why my rent went up?

scenes.image: The Serpent delighted, holding a checklist.
lines: [delighted] Twelve percent! And your branch is due for inspection.

scenes.image: The Serpent unrolling an endless lease scroll down the tree.

Vertical view of the Tree of Knowledge rebuilt as a towering, wobbly treehouse apartment complex with dozens of crammed balconies, laundry lines and ladders, a neighbor shaking a rug onto another's breakfast below.
A golden garden with a gold coin dropping out of a big letter O.
lines: [storybook] In this Eden, nobody ever ate the fruit. And now... Eden is full.
